Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Maya Consulting is excited to move to a publisher-led co-sell arrangement for the joint Generative Search offering. To get the GCP publisher path moving we need Redwood to:

- Review and sign the attached Co-sell Commitment Form (pdf)

For the solution brief, attaching an initial draft (redwood_jv-solution-brief-v1.odt) — it's lightweight and focused on developer onboarding and latency/cost differentiation. Please review and call out anything you want emphasized for the GCP listing.

Next steps (tentative):
- Thu 09/14: Redwood legal to confirm clause 4 -> Olga to sign
- Fri 09/15: Final solution brief and SKU map -> Olivia to provide comments
- Week of 09/18: Sara submits to GCP marketplace review

Cc'ing Ben and Vivek to align on metering and GTM commitments.

Best,
